title: Error Messages Omnipod Dash
symptom: After installing AAPS 3.1.0.3-dev-b, the user experiences frequent error messages: 'Setting temp basal might have basal failed if temp basal was previously running, it was canceled. please manually refresh pod status from the omnipod tab.', 'Unable to verify whether SMB bolus (0.35U) succeeded. Refresh pod status to confirm or deny this command.', and 'AndroidAPS not responding: close the app waiting'.
evidence_quote: Since the messages appear more frequently, I believe that a correction should be made.
